summary: The registrant, Wells Fargo Commercial Mortgage Securities, Inc., filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to report the replacement of the special servicer (Trimont LLC replaced by Green Loan Services LLC) for the Christiana Mall Mortgage Loan, which constitutes ~3.4% of the asset pool of the issuing entity (Wells Fargo Commercial Mortgage Trust 2018-C48). This is a routine administrative servicing event without any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. No deal terms, pricing, or premiums were stated. This filing is not a special situation.
